statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_visibility (
                relative_path VARCHAR(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                hidden TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                INDEX idx_media_visibility_hidden (hidden)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_delete_operations (
                operation_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
                manifest JSON NOT NULL,
                created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                INDEX idx_media_delete_state_created (state, created_at)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_audit_log (
                id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                session_id_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                target_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                source_summary TEXT NULL,
                result VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                detail TEXT NULL,
                client_ip VARCHAR(45) NULL,
                user_agent VARCHAR(512) NULL,
                request_id VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                trace_id CHAR(32) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                INDEX idx_audit_created_at (created_at),
                INDEX idx_audit_action (action)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webrtc_observation_events (
                id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                webrtc_ip VARCHAR(45) NULL,
                outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                matches_verified TINYINT(1) NOT NULL,
                observed_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                INDEX idx_webrtc_client_time (client_ip, observed_at, id),
                INDEX idx_webrtc_observed_time (webrtc_ip, observed_at, id),
                INDEX idx_webrtc_recent (observed_at, id)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webrtc_observation_summary (
                client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                webrtc_ip_key VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                webrtc_ip VARCHAR(45) NULL,
                observation_count BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
                matching_count BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
                first_seen DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                last_seen DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                last_outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (client_ip, webrtc_ip_key),
                INDEX idx_webrtc_summary_observed (webrtc_ip, last_seen),
                INDEX idx_webrtc_summary_recent (last_seen)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_audit_log (
                id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                detail JSON NOT NULL,
                session_id_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                request_id VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                trace_id CHAR(32) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                INDEX idx_ip_security_timeline (ip_address, created_at, id),
                INDEX idx_ip_security_violation_count (ip_address, action, created_at, id)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_summary (
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                attack_count BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                last_attack_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
                INDEX idx_ip_security_last_attack (last_attack_at, ip_address)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_locks (
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                projection_dirty TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                INDEX idx_ip_projection_dirty (projection_dirty, ip_address)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_projection (
                singleton TINYINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                generation BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                published_generation BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_auto_ban_events (
                id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                trigger_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
                window_started_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                banned_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                expires_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                last_method VARCHAR(16) NULL,
                last_path VARCHAR(2048) NULL,
                user_agent VARCHAR(512) NULL,
                ban_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto',
                reason VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_by_session_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                released_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
                released_by_session_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                active_ip_address VARCHAR(45)
                    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
                        CASE WHEN status='active' THEN ip_address ELSE NULL END
                    ) STORED,
                UNIQUE INDEX uq_ip_ban_active_ip (active_ip_address),
                INDEX idx_ip_ban_ip_time (ip_address, banned_at),
                INDEX idx_ip_ban_recent (banned_at, status),
                INDEX idx_ip_ban_expiry (expires_at, status)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_permanent_whitelist (
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                created_by_session_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                note VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                INDEX idx_ip_whitelist_created_at (created_at)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_objects (
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                object_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
                media_path VARCHAR(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
                path_locator CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE INDEX uq_media_objects_path_locator (path_locator),
                INDEX idx_media_objects_kind (object_kind),
                INDEX idx_media_objects_path (media_path(191))
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_playback_stats (
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                media_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
                play_score BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                preference INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                INDEX idx_playback_sort (preference, play_score),
                INDEX idx_playback_path (media_path(191)),
                CONSTRAINT chk_media_preference CHECK (preference BETWEEN -7 AND 500000)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_playback_events (
                playback_session_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                counted_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                expires_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (playback_session_id, media_id),
                INDEX idx_playback_event_expiry (expires_at),
                INDEX idx_playback_event_media (media_id)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_lyric_links (
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                media_path VARCHAR(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
                lyric_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                lyric_path VARCHAR(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
                created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
                INDEX idx_media_lyric_lyric_id (lyric_id),
                INDEX idx_media_lyric_updated_at (updated_at),
                INDEX idx_media_lyric_path (media_path(191)),
                INDEX idx_lyric_path (lyric_path(191))
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_backup_members (
	member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	last_success BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lag_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (member_id)

)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_business_backup_chunks (
	master_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload LONGBLOB NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (master_id, generation, chunk_index)

)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_business_backups (
	master_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (master_id, generation)
,
 INDEX idx_business_backup_latest (master_id, state, generation)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_compute_members (
	member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	worker_slots INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	available_slots INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cpu_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	memory_available_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	capabilities JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (member_id)

)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_storage_members (
	member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32), 
	member_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	transport VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	storage_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	allocated_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	physical_free_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	health VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	writable INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (member_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_storage_member_relationship UNIQUE (relationship_id)
,
 INDEX idx_storage_member_health (storage_enabled, health, writable)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_upload_sessions (
	upload_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	storage_member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	media_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	media_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	path_locator VARCHAR(64), 
	object_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	expected_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (upload_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_cluster_upload_path UNIQUE (path_locator)
,
 INDEX idx_cluster_upload_expiry (state, expires_at)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_worker_jobs (
	job_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_type VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	media_id VARCHAR(64), 
	member_id VARCHAR(32), 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	lease_token_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (job_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_cluster_worker_idempotency UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
,
 INDEX idx_cluster_worker_schedule (state, lease_expires_at)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS global_media_objects (
	media_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	object_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	media_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	path_locator VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	object_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	etag VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (media_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_global_media_path UNIQUE (path_locator), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_global_media_placement UNIQUE (storage_member_id, object_id)
,
 INDEX idx_global_media_member_state (storage_member_id, state),
 INDEX idx_global_media_path (media_path(191))
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_audit (
	audit_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32), 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (audit_id)
,
 INDEX idx_node_audit_time (created_at)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_identity (
	singleton INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	node_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	`role` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	endpoint VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	private_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (singleton)

)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_pair_packages (
	nonce VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32), 
	master_id VARCHAR(32), 
	PRIMARY KEY (nonce)

)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_relationships (
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	peer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	peer_endpoint VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	peer_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	credential TEXT NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	last_heartbeat BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	rtt_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failures INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recoveries INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	peer_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	protocol INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	summary JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (relationship_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_node_relationship_peer UNIQUE (peer_id)

)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_request_nonces (
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	nonce VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (relationship_id, nonce)
,
 INDEX idx_node_nonce_expiry (expires_at)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_audit_log (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id VARCHAR(32), 
	action VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	webrtc_addresses JSON NOT NULL, 
	detail JSON NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(128), 
	trace_id VARCHAR(32), 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
,
 INDEX idx_karaoke_audit_ip_time (client_ip, created_at),
 INDEX idx_karaoke_audit_user_time (user_id, created_at)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_recordings (
	recording_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	storage_member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	lyrics JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (recording_id)
,
 INDEX idx_karaoke_recording_member (storage_member_id, state),
 INDEX idx_karaoke_recording_user_time (user_id, created_at)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_registration_daily (
	client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	day_key VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	success_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (client_ip, day_key)

)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_users (
	user_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	username_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	quota_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_karaoke_user_name UNIQUE (username_key)
,
 INDEX idx_karaoke_users_status (status, created_at)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS frontiercloud_schema_migrations (
        generation INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        migration_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
        checksum CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
        applied_at BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE frontiercloud_schema (
                singleton TINYINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                generation INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
                created_at BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_encryption (object_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (object_kind IN ('media','recording_lyric')), object_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL, file_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, descriptor_json TEXT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (object_kind,object_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_crypto_keys (singleton INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, key_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT chk_media_crypto_key_singleton CHECK (singleton=1)) ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_tasks (
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
master_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
source_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
target_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
source_relationship CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
target_relationship CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
plan_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
plan JSON NOT NULL,
state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
object_count BIGINT NOT NULL,
total_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,
committed_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
CHECK (source_id <> target_id),
CHECK (object_count >= 0 AND total_bytes >= 0 AND committed_bytes >= 0 AND committed_bytes <= total_bytes),
CHECK (revision > 0),
CHECK (state IN ('queued','copying','verifying','committing','cleanup_pending','paused','cancelling','cancelled','failed','completed')),
INDEX idx_migration_task_state (state,updated_at),
INDEX idx_migration_task_source (source_id,state),
INDEX idx_migration_task_target (target_id,state)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_units (
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
unit_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
resource_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
parent_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
source_version CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
object_count BIGINT NOT NULL,
total_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,
committed_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
cleanup_after BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (task_id,unit_id),
CHECK (object_count > 0 AND total_bytes >= 0),
CHECK (resource_kind IN ('media','recording')),
CHECK (state IN ('pending','copying','verified','publishing','committed','cleanup_pending','cleaned','cancelled'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_objects (
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
unit_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
logical_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
resource_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
source_object CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
target_object CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
source_version CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
physical_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
expected_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,
source_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
target_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
verified_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (task_id,logical_id),
CHECK (expected_bytes >= 0 AND verified_bytes >= 0 AND verified_bytes <= expected_bytes),
CHECK (resource_kind IN ('media','recording')),
CHECK (state IN ('pending','copying','verified','publishing','published','cleanup_pending','cleaned','cancelled')),
INDEX idx_migration_object_unit (task_id,unit_id,state)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_capacity (
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
reserved_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
CHECK (reserved_bytes >= 0),
INDEX idx_migration_capacity_member (member_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_drains (
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
reason VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (member_id,owner_id),
CHECK (reason IN ('migration','administrator'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_scopes (
scope_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
resource_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
parent_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
CHECK (resource_kind IN ('media','recording')),
INDEX idx_migration_scope_task (task_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_runners (
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
runner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
epoch BIGINT NOT NULL,
expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
CHECK (epoch > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_storage_journal (
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
logical_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
unit_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
master_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
source_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
target_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
resource_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
object_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
physical_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
source_version CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
expected_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,
sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (task_id,logical_id),
CHECK (source_id <> target_id AND expected_bytes >= 0),
CHECK (resource_kind IN ('media','recording')),
CHECK (state IN ('receiving','verified','publishing','published','deleting','deleted','aborting','aborted')),
INDEX idx_migration_journal_state (state,updated_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_read_leases (
lease_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
logical_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
object_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
source_version CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
INDEX idx_migration_lease_member (member_id,expires_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_peer_bindings (
task_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
logical_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
binding_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
binding_json TEXT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (task_id,logical_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_plan_headers (
plan_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
master_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
source_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
target_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
header_json TEXT NOT NULL,
object_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
unit_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
total_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
catalog_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
proofs_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
plan_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
CHECK (source_id <> target_id),
CHECK (object_count >= 0 AND unit_count >= 0 AND total_bytes >= 0),
CHECK (state IN ('observing','ready','blocked','admitted'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_plan_bindings (
plan_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
logical_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
unit_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
resource_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
source_object CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
object_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
object_json TEXT NOT NULL,
expected_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,
source_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
native_metadata_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
native_seen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (plan_id,logical_id),
UNIQUE (plan_id,resource_kind,source_object),
CHECK (expected_bytes > 0),
CHECK (native_seen IN (0,1)),
CHECK (resource_kind IN ('media','recording')),
INDEX idx_migration_plan_unit (plan_id,unit_id,logical_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_plan_paths (
plan_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
resource_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
path_locator CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
entry_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (plan_id,resource_kind,path_locator,entry_kind),
CHECK (resource_kind IN ('media','recording')),
CHECK (entry_kind IN ('name','parent','ancestor'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s3_members (
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
endpoint VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
region VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
bucket VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
prefix VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
address_style VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto',
namespace_key VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
sealed_credentials TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (''),
credential_expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
credential_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
probe_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
probe_state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unchecked',
cleanup_only INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (member_id),
CHECK (revision > 0 AND credential_revision > 0 AND probe_revision >= 0),
CHECK (credential_expires_at >= 0),
CHECK (cleanup_only IN (0,1)),
INDEX idx_s3_member_namespace (namespace_key)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s3_uploads (
upload_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
object_key VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
object_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
provider_upload_id VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reserved',
revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
credential_revision BIGINT NOT NULL,
create_uncertain INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
grant_until BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
absolute_expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
confirmed_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
proof_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('{}'),
error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (upload_id),
CHECK (revision > 0 AND credential_revision > 0),
CHECK (create_uncertain IN (0,1)),
CHECK (grant_until >= 0 AND absolute_expires_at >= created_at),
CHECK (confirmed_bytes >= 0 AND confirmed_bytes <= 10737418240),
UNIQUE INDEX uq_s3_upload_object (object_id),
INDEX idx_s3_upload_member (member_id,state),
INDEX idx_s3_upload_state (state,updated_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s3_upload_parts (
upload_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
part_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,
checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(44) NOT NULL,
etag VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
grant_until BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (upload_id,part_number),
CHECK (part_number BETWEEN 1 AND 1280),
CHECK (size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608),
CHECK (confirmed IN (0,1)),
CHECK (grant_until >= 0),
CHECK (LENGTH(checksum_sha256)=44)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s3_objects (
media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
object_key VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
object_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
proof_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('{}'),
state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
grant_until BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (media_id),
CHECK (revision > 0 AND grant_until >= 0),
UNIQUE INDEX uq_s3_object_identity (object_id),
INDEX idx_s3_object_member (member_id,state),
INDEX idx_s3_object_state (state,updated_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s3_probe_journal (
probe_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
member_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
revision BIGINT NOT NULL,
credential_revision BIGINT NOT NULL,
object_key VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
provider_upload_id VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
version_id VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
etag VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'creating',
grant_until BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (probe_id),
CHECK (revision > 0 AND credential_revision > 0 AND grant_until >= 0),
INDEX idx_s3_probe_member (member_id,state),
INDEX idx_s3_probe_state (state,updated_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
